lines.en: label nodokaspring2:
scene nodokawhite1
scene nodokawhite2
Be it unmarked graves or containers of soup. Be it troubles or bubbles or birds in a coop.
lines.zh: 无论是无名的坟墓还是一碗汤。无论是麻烦、泡泡还是笼中鸟。

lines.en: I’m a daughter to slaughter, the laughter soon after. A welcome mat welcoming act full of chatter.
lines.zh: 我是待宰的女儿，紧随其后的是笑声。是一张铺满闲话的、迎客的脚垫。

lines.en: While I know that you worry, don’t hurry, time’s stopped! There’s no need to get out of that chair you’ve got.
lines.zh: 我知道你在担心，但别着急，时间已经停了！你没必要从你那张椅子里站起来。

lines.en: If anything many things beckon your notice. On your knees, God’s presenting, commanding you “blow this.”
lines.zh: 如果有任何东西——很多东西——在召唤你的注意。跪下吧，神正在呈现，命令你「把这个吹了」。

lines.en: So you do! And, oh! How delicious it tastes!
lines.zh: 于是你照做了！而，哦！那味道多么美妙！

lines.en: These subservient perversions, these ol’ quantum aversions, they combine to make {b}You{/b} and enhance the immersion!
lines.zh: 这些臣服的变态，这些老旧的量子厌恶，它们合在一起塑造了「{b}你{/b}」，并强化了这份沉浸感！

lines.en: Please enjoy your stay in the place that you are for the places you aren’t are now {b}CLOSED.{/b}
lines.zh: 请好好享受你所在的这个地方吧——因为你不所在的那些地方，如今已经{b}关闭{/b}了。

lines.en: scene nodokawhite3
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: scene nodokawhite4
: Where the fuck am I now?! I was so close to doing something and now I don’t even know what I was close to doing!
lines.zh: : 我他妈现在到底在哪儿？！我差一点就要做成什么事了，可现在我连自己差一点要做成什么都不记得了！

lines.en: : Isn’t something pink supposed to be there?! To cut this white in two while I spend the night with {i}you?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 那儿是不是该有个粉色的东西？！好把这片白色一分为二，让我好跟{i}你{/i}共度良宵？！

lines.en: scene nodokawhite5

: Wait, who are {i}you?!{/i} And why did I say that when I’m entirely, completely, unmistakably alone?! Stop hijacking my mind, secret invisible Nodoka! I know you’re there! I know you’re {i}judging{/i} me!
lines.zh: : 等等，{i}你{/i}是谁？！我明明是完完全全、彻彻底底、毫无疑问地一个人，为什么我会说那种话？！别再劫持我的脑子了，隐形的秘密 Nodoka！我知道你在那儿！我知道你在{i}评判{/i}我！

lines.en: : {size=-4}And because I know {i}these{/i} things, I also know that locking me in a liminal white space is little more than a malicious attempt to invoke my historical musings on colorblindness and subsequently beat me down into a girl more susceptible to brainwashing!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-4}而且正因为我知道这些，我也知道——把我锁在一个阈限的白色空间里，无非是一种恶意的尝试，想唤起我对色盲的历史性沉思，进而把我打垮成一个更容易被洗脑的女孩！{/size}

lines.en: : I am smarter than you! Smarter than me! And I can easily remember how to move these limbs and exit this chair! I just haven’t {i}tried{/i} yet!
lines.zh: : 我比你聪明！比我自己还聪明！而且我很容易就能想起来该怎么动这些胳膊腿、离开这把椅子！我只是还没{i}试{/i}而已！

lines.en: scene nodokawhite6
: Waiter? Yes, hello. Just a coffee please. Black. Thank you. And no, I’m not writing a screenplay.
lines.zh: : 服务生？啊，你好。只要一杯咖啡，谢谢。黑的。谢谢。不，我没在写剧本。

lines.en: : What, this? Just research on how to get from here to there. Have you ever used a GPS? Cool, well it’s nothing like that. 店内で。
lines.zh: : 什么，这个？只是研究一下怎么从这里到那里。你用过 GPS 吗？很好，这玩意儿跟那个一点都不像。店内で (在店里)。

lines.en: scene nodokawhite7

: {size=-2}My {i}number?!{/i} Are you sure? Even though I’ve been repeatedly passionately reamed by a man twice my age and twice my size? That doesn’t bother- oh, you meant my order number. 1232. Ha ha ha. I’m so silly.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}我的号码？！你确定吗？尽管我被一个年龄是我两倍、体型是我两倍的男人反复热情地捅过？这一点都不——哦，你说的是我的取餐号。1232。哈哈哈。我真傻。{/size}

lines.en: scene nodokawhite8
: FUCK! NO! I didn’t come here to not work on my screenplay! I came here because...think, Nodoka! Library! You were in a library! There was a book! {i}Your{/i} book! A book full of tips and-
lines.zh: : 操！不！我来这儿可不是为了不写我的剧本！我来这儿是因为……想啊，Nodoka！图书馆！你刚才在图书馆！有一本书！{i}你的{/i}书！一本写满了技巧和——

lines.en: scene nodokawhite9
: AH-HAH! I REMEMBER HOW TO WALK NOW! I CAN ONLY SUPPRESS MYSELF FOR SO LONG!
lines.zh: : 啊哈！我想起该怎么走路了！我没法压抑自己太久！

lines.en: : I MUST PICK UP ORDER 1232 FROM THE COUNTER BEFORE SOME FUCKING ASSHOLE GETS THEIR GRUBBY UNINTELLECTUAL HANDS ALL OVER IT!!!!
lines.zh: : 我必须在某个狗日的混蛋用他们那油腻的无知双手碰它之前，从柜台上取走 1232 号订单！！！！

lines.en: scene black
scene nodokawhite10
Each step Nodoka took caused a large satin curtain covering a window to another world (?) to slightly raise until it receded into the ceiling and left her staring blankly at a room with clocks.
lines.zh: Nodoka 每走一步，都让一大块遮住通往另一个世界（？）的窗户的缎面窗帘稍稍升起，直到它缩进天花板，留她茫然地盯着一间摆满钟的房间。

lines.en: There were other things in the room too, though. Not just the one she was looking at, but the one she was in.
lines.zh: 不过房间里还有别的东西。不只是她在看的那一件，还有她身处的那一件。

lines.en: As we speak, beings are slowly materializing in my place. And while all that currently tangibly exists are two nervous systems, the rest of the meat will be here soon and then the meat will learn to speak.
lines.zh: 就在我们说话的这会儿，一个个存在正慢慢在我的位置上具象化。虽然目前切实存在的只有两套神经系统，但其余的肉很快就会到，然后那肉就会学会说话。

lines.en: This makes my system nervous too!
lines.zh: 这让我的系统也很紧张！

lines.en: : Fascinating. A Passer montanus. Just the like the one we have in the dorm. And what an interesting enclosure for it.
lines.zh: : 有意思。一只 Passer montanus。就跟宿舍里那只一样。而它这个 enclosure 也相当有趣。

lines.en: The bird chirps delightedly.
lines.zh: 鸟儿欢快地啾啾叫。

lines.en: scene nodokawhite11

: Are you eating well, my sudden avian companion? Those sunflowers are far too large for you. You should be feasting on something smaller. Like millet. Do you want some millet? Where can I get some millet?
lines.zh: : 你吃得好吗，我突然出现的鸟类伙伴？那些向日葵对你来说太大了。你该吃些更小的东西。比如小米。你想要点小米吗？我去哪儿能弄到小米？

lines.en: The bird chirps delightedly again. It’s in a good mood probably. And the meat is still forming.
lines.zh: 鸟儿又欢快地啾啾叫。它心情大概不错。而肉还在成形。

lines.en: : Is this truly all yours, bird? Are you not lonely, having such a large box to yourself?
lines.zh: : 这一切真的都属于你吗，小鸟？拥有这么大一个箱子，你不孤单吗？

lines.en: : I often feel the same, you know. Are there things in there you’re not allowed to use? Does your master give you rules on what you can and can not enrich yourself with? Or are you masterless, like me?
lines.zh: : 我常常也有同感，你知道的。那里面有没有什么你不许用的东西？你的主人有没有给你定规矩，规定什么可以、什么不可以用来充实自己？还是说你和我一样，没有主人？

lines.en: Chirp chirp chirp. Meat soon. She hears mild chatter through the door through the mirror. Less like teeth, more like people.
lines.zh: 啾啾啾。肉快好了。她透过门、透过镜子听见了轻微的说话声。不像牙齿，更像人。

lines.en: : Okay. HEAD IN THE GAME. Like you’re playing FOOTBALL, Nodoka. Like it’s fucking FOOTBALL. How do I play FOOTBALL?
lines.zh: : 好。专心。就像你在打橄榄球一样，Nodoka。就像那该死的橄榄球。我该怎么打橄榄球？

lines.en: : BIRD! HELP!
lines.zh: : 小鸟！救命！

lines.en: The chirp birds delightedly.
lines.zh: 鸟儿欢快地啾啾。

lines.en: : I’ve found myself in fucking SYMBOLISM again! All I want is to use a fucking DOOR but the only DOOR in here is on the other side of a WINDOW. This implication is FUCKING SHIT!
lines.zh: : 我又他妈掉进象征主义里了！我只想用一扇该死的门，可这里唯一的门却在一扇窗户的另一边。这暗示真是狗屁不如！

lines.en: : We can show you the way if you’re lost, Nagasawa-san.
lines.zh: : 如果你迷路了，我们可以给你指路，Nagasawa 小姐。

lines.en: scene nodokawhite12
: Get out of my FUCKING CHAIR!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 从我的狗屁椅子上滚出去！！！！！！

lines.en: scene nodokawhite13
scene nodokawhite12
: Please forgive Moyo here. Her legs aren’t what they used to be. They’re actually legs now.
lines.zh: : 请原谅 Moyo。她的腿已经不是从前那样了。它们现在是真的腿了。

lines.en: : Cool. I DON’T FUCKING CARE. Where’s the library?! I HAVE OVERDUE BOOKS TO RETURN!
lines.zh: : 酷。我他妈才不在乎。图书馆在哪儿？！我有逾期未还的书要还！

lines.en: : The library is a {i}long{/i} way from here, Nagasawa-san. You were captured by the Gardener and put into detention. Your only option now is to either do as we say or spend the next nine hours and twenty minutes here.
lines.zh: : 图书馆离这儿{i}很远{/i}，Nagasawa 小姐。你被园丁抓住，关了禁闭。你现在的唯一选择，要么照我们说的做，要么在这里待上九小时二十分钟。

lines.en: scene nodokawhite14
: NINE HOURS and TWENTY MINUTES?! That’s almost the exact runtime of the 1985 Holocaust documentary, “Shoah!”
lines.zh: : 九小时二十分钟？！那几乎正好是 1985 年那部大屠杀纪录片《浩劫》的片长！

lines.en: : Why do you know that?
lines.zh: : 你怎么会知道这个？

lines.en: : Because I’m SMART! I know EVERYTHING! Except all of the things that are happening HERE! Now, why are you so fucking LONG all of a sudden?!
lines.zh: : 因为我聪明！我什么都知道！除了这里正在发生的一切！还有，你为什么突然变得这么长？！

lines.en: scene nodokawhite15
: Forgive me for not properly introducing myself. I am me. And this is her. And we’re here today to try and get you to join our company softball team.
lines.zh: : 请原谅我没好好自我介绍。我就是我。而这是她。我们今天来，是想请你加入我们的公司垒球队。

lines.en: : Turn that one off. She disgusts me with her unusual frequency.
lines.zh: : 把那个关掉。她那不寻常的频率让我恶心。

lines.en: : You’ll get used to it in time. Which it seems you’re running out of, if what my sources tell me is true.
lines.zh: : 你迟早会习惯的。而看起来你的时间不多了——如果我的消息来源没错的话。

lines.en: : AHHHHHHH! Get the fucking DVD player! I’ll just skip to the second half of Shoah!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！去把那台该死的 DVD 机拿来！我直接跳到《浩劫》的后半段！

lines.en: : Are you always this {i}rambunctious{/i} during fits of frantic delirium?
lines.zh: : 你在神志狂乱的发作期里，总是这么{i}暴躁{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Where’s the fucking BARISTA with my COFFEE? 1232! I’VE BEEN WAITING HERE FOREVER!
lines.zh: : 那个该死的咖啡师和我的咖啡在哪儿？1232！我都在这儿等了一辈子了！

lines.en: scene nodokawhite16
: I said COFFEE, not EEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!

: Apologies, Nagasawa-san. Moyo’s been very eager to show off her paper lantern tongue rings and kanji tattoos lately. Two things that {i}you{/i} could have as well if only you join our softball team.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Nagasawa 小姐。Moyo 最近很想炫耀她的纸灯笼舌环和汉字纹身。只要{i}你{/i}加入我们的垒球队，这两样你也可以有。

lines.en: : I don’t have time for SOFTBALL! Those tongue rings are certainly intriguing, though. Do you know whose bird this is?
lines.zh: : 我没时间搞垒球！不过那些舌环确实挺有意思。你们知道这只鸟是谁的吗？

lines.en: scene nodokawhite17
: I haven’t hated something this much since Walden. How much longer does it have to live?
lines.zh: : 自《瓦尔登湖》之后，我还没这么讨厌过什么东西。它还能活多久？

lines.en: : She’s already well past her expiration date. But so is your mother and she’s still clinging to life, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 她早就过了保质期了。可你妈也一样，她不还赖活着吗？

lines.en: scene nodokawhite18
: My mother?...
lines.zh: : 我母亲？……

lines.en: : How do you know about my mother?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道我母亲的事？

lines.en: scene nodokawhite19
: The same way we know about {i}you.{/i} You’re on a different side of the screen. A commercial from a different decade. One who wants to know her origin, but has been unable to figure anything out.
lines.zh: : 跟我们知道{i}你{/i}的方式一样。你在屏幕的另一边。来自另一个年代的一则广告。一个想知道自己起源的人，却什么都没弄明白。

lines.en: : LIES! My origin could be a puddle of fucking MANATEE SEMEN for all I care! What I want to know is HOW? WHY? And if she can even SEE ME.
lines.zh: : 谎言！我的起源就算是他妈的一滩海牛精液，我也无所谓！我想知道的是怎么做到的？为什么？还有她到底能不能看见我。

lines.en: : And these are answers we can help you find. But not without first establishing a contract.
lines.zh: : 而这些答案，我们可以帮你找到。但得先立一份契约。

lines.en: : How does ten years for $700,000,000 sound? It’s the same contract Shohei Ohtani got from the Los Angeles Dodgers, but without any of the deferrals.
lines.zh: : 十年七亿美元，听起来怎么样？跟 Shohei Ohtani 从洛杉矶道奇队拿到的那份合同一样，只是没有任何递延支付。

lines.en: : I have no use for MONEY! TIME is fucking INFINITE! Anything I WANT I can just TAKE!
lines.zh: : 钱对我没用！时间是无限的！我想要的任何东西我都可以直接拿！

lines.en: : Not knowledge. And you have to admit, it irks you not knowing something that other people {i}do{/i} know, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 知识不行。而且你得承认，别人知道而你不知道的某件事，会让你恼火，不{i}是{/i}吗？

lines.en: scene nodokawhite20
: Your whole life, you’ve existed on a plane much different from everyone else. Unable to connect. Unable to understand. And it’s all for good reason.
lines.zh: : 你这一生，都存在于一个跟其他人截然不同的层面上。无法连接。无法理解。而这一切都是有充分理由的。

lines.en: : You are special, Nagasawa-san. An entity that, by all accounts, should not exist. Yet you {i}do.{/i} And, in that regard, the two of us are rather similar.
lines.zh: : 你是特别的，Nagasawa 小姐。一个从任何角度来说都不该存在的存在。可你{i}确实{/i}存在。而在这一点上，我们俩相当相似。

lines.en: scene black
scene nodokawhite21
: You are the byproduct of mistakes never made. The unripe fruit of virgin birth. One that, when eaten, would condemn man to a life of sin.
lines.zh: : 你是那些从未犯下的错误的副产品。是处女生育结出的未熟之果。一旦被吃下，就会把人类定罪为一生有罪。

lines.en: : It’s no wonder you’re such a floppy little fish-girl!
lines.zh: : 怪不得你是这么一条软趴趴的小鱼女！

lines.en: : I am not a {i}fish-girl.{/i} You take that back, you fucking mutant. What else do you know about Kyoko?
lines.zh: : 我不是{i}鱼女{/i}。把话收回去，你这该死的变种人。关于 Kyoko 你还知道什么？

lines.en: : What else do {i}you{/i} know about her?
lines.zh: : 关于她，{i}你{/i}又知道什么？

lines.en: : All of your knowledge comes from books. Mementos. Articles left behind that you’ve dedicated yourself to deciphering, yet repeatedly {i}fail{/i} behind the scenes much to your own genius dismay!
lines.zh: : 你所有的知识都来自书本。遗物。被留下的文章——你把自己奉献给了解读它们，却在幕后反复{i}失败{/i}，令你那天才的自己沮丧不已！

lines.en: : It’s so sad! The one thing you actually {i}want{/i} to know is the one thing you {i}can’t{/i} because anything you learn would make it harder for you to learn anything {i}else!{/i}
lines.zh: : 太可悲了！你唯一真正{i}想{/i}知道的事，恰恰是你{i}无法{/i}知道的那件——因为你学到的任何东西，都会让你更难学到{i}别的{/i}东西！

lines.en: : You fear death the same way we all do. But you also fear deathless uncertainty. You fear the deathless unknown. And all of these things are at war with one another. So the time has come to make a choice.
lines.zh: : 你像我们所有人一样恐惧死亡。但你也恐惧不死的确定性。你恐惧那不死的未知。而所有这些东西正在彼此交战。所以，是时候做出选择了。

lines.en: : You can leave Kumon-mi behind. And you may come with us to the Sanctuary, where we will tell you everything you have ever wanted to know about everything there {i}is{/i} to know.
lines.zh: : 你可以把 Kumon-mi 抛在身后。你可以跟我们一起去庇护所，在那里我们会把你想知道的一切、关于一切{i}可知{/i}之事的一切，都告诉你。

lines.en: : What’s the catch? And if you mention fucking softball again, I swear to god.
lines.zh: : 有什么陷阱？如果你再提一句该死的垒球，我对天发誓。

lines.en: : The catch is that Kyoko dies. Which, let’s face it, she already {i}has.{/i}
lines.zh: : 陷阱就是 Kyoko 会死。而说实话，她{i}早就{/i}死了。

lines.en: scene nodokawhite22
: There’s nothing in there. There {i}used{/i} to be, sure. But those times have never been known to you.
lines.zh: : 那里面什么都没有。{i}以前{/i}有过，没错。但那些年代对你来说从未被知晓过。

lines.en: : You never even {i}had{/i} a childhood. You just {i}showed up{/i} one day and the world rewrote itself. You really think you’re the only one who knows that?
lines.zh: : 你甚至从未{i}有过{/i}童年。你就是某天突然{i}出现{/i}了，然后世界重写了它自己。你真以为只有你一个人知道这件事吗？

lines.en: : Come with us. We’ll rewrite it all again. And soon, {i}you{/i} can be the Passer montanus, complete with your own little aviary.
lines.zh: : 跟我们走吧。我们会把它全部重写一遍。很快，{i}你{/i}就能成为那只 Passer montanus，拥有属于自己的小鸟舍。

lines.en: : You don’t want me. You want {i}her.{/i} And appealing to my thirst for knowledge will do nothing to sate your appetite for reconciliation. I am not so easily led astray.
lines.zh: : 你们想要的不是我。是{i}她{/i}。而诉诸我对知识的渴望，根本满足不了你们对和解的胃口。我没那么容易被带偏。

lines.en: scene nodokawhite23
: You’d rob yourself of the chance to see God? All to protect a mannequin who has never once shown you love?
lines.zh: : 你宁愿放弃亲眼见到神的机会？就为了保全一个从未对你示过爱的人体模型？

lines.en: : Why not tell me what killing her would do for you? If her existence is so devoid of {i}everything,{/i} why go to such lengths to put an end to it?
lines.zh: : 为什么不告诉我，杀了她对你们有什么好处？如果她的存在如此{i}空洞{/i}，你们何必大费周章地去终结它？

lines.en: : I’m just a middle-girl. It’s my employer who doesn’t want her to exist anymore. And if said employer could form a contract with someone like you in the process, it sweetens the deal even more.
lines.zh: : 我只是个中间人。是我的雇主不希望她再存在下去。而如果这位雇主能在此过程中与像你这样的人订立契约，那这买卖就更划算了。

lines.en: : I can’t see how when whoever {i}you{/i} lot are seem to possess the only bits of information in this world that I lack.
lines.zh: : 我不明白——毕竟{i}你{/i}们这帮人似乎掌握着这个世界上我唯一缺乏的那些信息。

lines.en: : It’s less about what you {i}know{/i} and more about what you can {i}teach.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这与其说是关于你{i}知道{/i}什么，不如说是关于你能{i}教{/i}什么。

lines.en: : We’ve had enough lessons in love for a while, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 我们已经上了够久的爱的课了，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！

lines.en: scene nodokawhite24
: ABOUT FUCKING TIME! That elongated CUNT over there has been trying to get me to KILL MY MOM!
lines.zh: : 该他妈的到时候了！那边那个被拉长的臭婊子一直在试图让我杀了我妈！

lines.en: : I tried to warn you, Nodoka-chan! But before I knew it, that green guy was tying me up and it only felt kind of good!
lines.zh: : 我试着警告过你了，Nodoka 酱！可我还没反应过来，那个绿色的家伙就把我绑起来了，而且那感觉还挺不错的！

lines.en: : What green guy?! I didn’t see a fucking green guy!
lines.zh: : 什么绿色的家伙？！我根本没看见什么该死的绿色家伙！

lines.en: : Because you never pay attention! Anyway, what’s all this about killing your-
lines.zh: : 因为你从来不专心！总之，杀你那什么的——

lines.en: scene nodokawhite25
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : What? Is there another green person now?
lines.zh: : 怎么？现在又来了一个绿色的人？

lines.en: : No! I just didn’t realize the twins were here! They’re always so creepy!
lines.zh: : 不是！我只是没注意到那对双胞胎在这儿！她们总是那么瘆人！

lines.en: : Twins? You and I look more like twins than the two of them do and you’re a fucking stick figure.
lines.zh: : 双胞胎？你我和她们比起来才更像双胞胎，而你还他妈是个火柴人。

lines.en: : Ugh, really?! I need to stop sharing my garlic bread. This whole time, I thought I was {i}gaining{/i} weight, not {i}losing{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 呃，真的吗？！我得别再分我的蒜香面包了。这么久以来，我以为我在{i}长胖{/i}，不是在{i}变瘦{/i}。

lines.en: scene nodokawhite26
: Anyway! Ready to get out of here? I might not be {i}super{/i} useful, but even somebody like me can pull you out of detention!
lines.zh: : 总之！准备好离开这儿了吗？我可能不怎么顶用，但就连我这样的人也能把你从禁闭里弄出去！

lines.en: : If you’re going to kill them, start with the small one.
lines.zh: : 如果你要杀她们，从小的那个开始。

lines.en: : Hahahahah! Good idea, Nodoka-chan!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈！好主意，Nodoka 酱！

lines.en: scene nodokawhite27
: No.
: Ngah...ahh?!
: I know it hurts, but this is the only way to save you!
lines.zh: : 我知道这很疼，但这是唯一能救你的办法！

lines.en: scene nodokawhite28
: Glchkk....you....f....fucking...traitor!
lines.zh: : 咕……你……这……这该死的……叛徒！

lines.en: : Hey, I’m saving you from nine hours and twenty minutes worth of mind games right now! You should be {i}thanking{/i} me!
lines.zh: : 嘿，我这是在救你，让你免于九小时二十分钟的心理游戏！你该{i}谢{/i}我才对！

lines.en: : Warn the...next one! About...their offer! T...glchk...tell her...not to...take it!!!
lines.zh: : 警告……下一个！关于……他们的提议！告……咕呃……告诉她……别……接受！！！

lines.en: : Well, {i}duh.{/i} I hate their stupid ultimatum even more than you do.
lines.zh: : {i}那还用说{/i}。我比你更讨厌他们那套愚蠢的最后通牒。

lines.en: scene nodokawhite29
: Mngh...glhpp....mnghhh....chklkhchh...
lines.zh: : 嗯……咕噜……嗯……咳噜咳……

lines.en: : Oh, jeez...Yuko-nee’s gonna yell at me for making such a big mess again.
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪……Yuko-nee 又要因为我弄出这么大一片狼藉而骂我了。

lines.en: : Moyo. Catch her.
lines.zh: : Moyo。抓住她。

lines.en: : EEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEKKKK!
scene nodokawhite30
: Hello, you? It’s me. It happened again.
lines.zh: : 喂，是你吗？是我。又发生了。

lines.en: : Yes, she’s chasing after her right now.
lines.zh: : 是的，她正在追她。

lines.en: : Yes, that’s-
lines.zh: : 是的，那是——

lines.en: : Oh.
: Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？

lines.en: : Well, that’s not good at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那可一点都不妙。

lines.en: $ nodokaspring2 = True
jump nodokaspring3
